description: Interior design and built-in carpentry for The Orie, a condominium in District 12, around Toa Payoh and Balestier. send Maison your approved plan.
intro: The Orie is a condominium at Lorong 1 Toa Payoh, in District 12, developed by City Developments Limited. CDL’s figures, as recorded in our project file, are 777 homes on a 99-year lease that started on 13 February 2024. The CDL construction page, current as at 2 November 2026, gives an indicative TOP in the third quarter of 2027. That is a developer estimate and is subject to change. It is not an obtained TOP, and it is not your personal key date. The project was launched in January 2025; it sits in this list because of the 2027 TOP window, not because it is a fresh launch. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your The Orie renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your The Orie interior
sections.text:
Toa Payoh is a mature, well-connected central-north town. Owners here often already know the neighbourhood — markets, schools, the town centre — and come to renovation with a clear brief: make a new condo work like a long-term home. In a development of this size, unit types will vary, and we do not have an official floor-plan set on file to list them. What we can say, without inventing a layout, is what usually needs to be designed once you have your approved plan. Most new-launch owners start with the kitchen (fitted base and tall units, a pantry, and a worktop that can take daily cooking), a living-room joinery wall, and full-height wardrobes in the main and common bedrooms. Where a study or a flexible common room exists, a built-in desk and wardrobe run is more useful than a loose table.

Maison is an interior designer. The work is built-in carpentry, specified and photographed the way a professional interior job is finished — tight junctions, consistent grain, proper shadows around a feature wall — not a show-flat of loose furniture. We can work from a wide living view or from closer studies of a wardrobe, a headboard wall or a kitchen run, depending on what you need to decide.

With an indicative TOP in late 2027, the useful work now is preparation rather than a rushed on-site start. Share your unit type and the approved plan when you have them, and we can freeze a design, a materials list and a budget range before keys. After handover, inspect defects and obtain management approval before fabrication goes in. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals; that is an editorial planning figure, not a guarantee. We are not affiliated with CDL.

faq.q: When is TOP or key collection at The Orie?
faq.a: Our project file records: 2027-Q3 indicative TOP. Where the note says indicative or expected, treat it as a developer estimate, not an obtained TOP and not your personal key date. Check with the developer for your own appointment.

faq.q: Do you have the The Orie floor plan?
faq.a: No official floor-plan or site image is on file for this page, so none is published here. Please send your approved unit plan.

faq.q: Can I renovate right after keys?
faq.a: After handover, inspect defects and obtain the management corporation’s renovation approval first. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals; that is an editorial allowance, not a guarantee.
Your approved floor plan, unit type if you have it, and a key date if one is already in writing. WhatsApp us at https://wa.me/6593391185.
